integrity: The proof combines published structural lemmas with an exhaustive exact-integer compatibility-graph enumeration. The verifier generates every relevant prime below 2^15, computes multiplicative orders exactly, enumerates all target-size cliques, and applies Korselt divisibility to the sole size-15 survivor; no probabilistic or heuristic step is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a finite lower bound only: it neither constructs a composite T-Fermat integer nor excludes examples with at least 16 distinct prime divisors. The finite computation relies on the structural lemmas cited from arXiv:2603.00679v2.
title: Sixteen-prime lower bound for composite T-Fermat integers
